title: brassica villosa subsp. drepanensis
intro: Brassica villosa subsp. drepanensis, commonly known as  Balkan horseradish, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, helping to alleviate respiratory issues and digestive problems. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as glucosinolates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Balkan horseradish include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
